title: Finite horizontal strip row augmentation induces a total quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], K an integer-indexed commuting double cochain complex whose total exists [def-sp-double-complex-total], and r≥0. Suppose K.X p is zero whenever p<0 or r≤p. Let A be an integer cochain complex, a_n:A.X n→(K.X 0).X n arbitrary morphisms, and b:A→Tot K a chain map with b.f n=a_n followed by the (0,n) diagonal inclusion. Assume for every n there exists a quasi-isomorphism f_n:A.X n[0]→K.flip.X n whose zero component is the canonical single-term identification followed by a_n. Then b is a quasi-isomorphism. There is no vertical boundedness hypothesis and no injectivity or sheaf hypothesis.

source.place: Lemma 12.25.4, variant in the second variable, as used in Tag 08C1; finite horizontal strip case.

proof.text: Choose the row maps f from hrows, retaining their component equalities and quasi-isomorphism proofs. Apply finite_strip_cone_filtration to the actual augmentation b to obtain its explicit vertical filtration F, bounds n-r and n+2, and graded homology comparisons with Cone(f p). This is an elimination of existential witnesses inside a proposition proof, not a definition of data from an unproved existence theorem.

The acyclic-cone criterion applied to each quasi-isomorphism f p makes every row cone acyclic. Transport its zero homology in degree n-p across the graded homology isomorphism and use exactAt_iff_isZero_homology to make F.gradedPiece p acyclic in every degree.

Apply degreewiseFiltered_acyclic to F with the supplied bounds, giving Cone(b).Acyclic. Apply the acyclic-cone criterion to b, obtaining QuasiIso b. The hypotheses and signature are unchanged, and all arguments work when r=0.

proof_origin.place: Second-variable finite-strip case, via cone vertical filtration and existing degreewise filtered acyclicity

theorem quasiIso_of_finite_strip_row_augmentation
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (K : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    [K.HasTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ)] (r : ℕ)
    (hsupport : ∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 ∨ (r : ℤ) ≤ p → IsZero (K.X p))
    (A : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (a : ∀ n : ℤ, A.X n ⟶ (K.X 0).X n)
    (b : A ⟶ K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (hb : ∀ n : ℤ, b.f n =
      a n ≫ K.ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 n n (Int.zero_add n))
    (hrows : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ f :
      (HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj (A.X n) ⟶ K.flip.X n,
      f.f 0 = (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 (A.X n)).hom ≫ a n ∧ QuasiIso f) :
    QuasiIso b
